frase_gancho.texto: Squares of public scribes, Baroque colleges, murals, and streets of old books.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The last stretch climbs north to Santo Domingo Square. Here stand the Dominican church and the former Palace of the Inquisition, now the Museum of Medicine. From there you walk toward the colleges and the murals: the historic headquarters of the Ministry of Public Education, the Former College of San Ildefonso, and the Church of La Enseñanza. The route ends at the Museum of Caricature and Donceles Street, famous for its used bookstores and for the Esperanza Iris City Theater. There are eight stops.
